messages:
maria_cs: Quick post-call capture for MeridianAI pilot (09:42 PT). Finance hit a red flag on usage; dropping asks so Product/ENG can triage.

maria_cs: Meridian's asks / pain points (raw):
- exportable per-route billing (CSV/Excel) with daily granularity and 'project' tag; CFO wants a single file to show in meetings
- ability to set embed-vector TTL per-project (they call out vectors going stale after reindex)
- prefer an option to 'freeze' a route to the current model version during pilots (they need UI-level control)
- clearer throttling reasons in logs (429 cause: rate vs concurrency vs hard quota) + suggested mitigations
- a small onboarding slice: 7-day condensed report (tokens, embedding calls, err rates) emailed to the customer admin

maria_cs: Customer quote: "We can't go to procurement without a straightforward export. The spike made our CFO pause the pilot."

noah_product: Good capture. Can CS paste the route name + an example day with the spike so ENG can pull traces? Also TTL: are they asking eviction or tombstone flag?

maria_cs: Route: meridian-search-main. Spike sample: 2026-03-18 (UTC). TTL = server-side eviction configurable per-project (they mentioned 1d / 7d options).

ryan_eng: I'll grab metric slices for 2026-03-18 and check for overlapping batch jobs / cache churn. Short workaround: we can add a CLI billing export grouped by tag this week.

celine_support: I'll offer the CLI-export + a manual daily CSV while ENG scopes the Console export. Also will gather the exact CSV fields Meridian needs.

noah_product: Proposal: split into M1 (billing transparency + 7-day onboarding email = P0) and M2 (TTL controls + model-freeze UI + throttle diagnostics = P1). Agree @taylor_pm?

taylor_pm: Agree. Metered export + onboarding email = P0 (owner=noah_product, ETA ~10 business days). TTL investigation = owner=ryan_eng (investigate feasibility, ETA 1 sprint). Model-freeze UI = owner=pm-ui, add to backlog but consider a lightweight toggle if low-effort.

infra_bot: Ticket INF-5107 created: per-route billing CSV export (https://jira.redwood/INF-5107).

infra_bot: Ticket INF-5108 created: onboarding 7-day condensed report (https://jira.redwood/INF-5108).

ryan_eng: I'll attach Grafana links + quick repro to INF-5107 by EOD. Note to ENG folks: check embedding client retry loops and KV cache TTL around 03/18.

maria_cs: Action items for CS:
- share Meridian's finance contact and acceptable CSV columns (owner=maria_cs) by tomorrow AM
- offer manual CSV export + temporary tag-based billing split now (owner=celine_support)

noah_product: CS, please include 2-3 prioritized use cases for the CSV (e.g., CFO summary, engineering investigation, monthly invoicing) so we can design columns accordingly.

maria_cs: Will DM Meridian finance and paste examples once I have permission. tagging #renewal-risk.

taylor_pm: We'll track INF-5107/5108 in planning. Keep short status updates here; we'll escalate if we see payer blocking.

infra_bot: Note: thread retention 90 days.
